scenarios.title: Sign in
scenarios.assertion: The configured synthetic user reaches the dashboard.

scenarios.title: Create invoice
scenarios.assertion: A new fixture invoice records the intended customer, amount and status.

scenarios.title: Search
scenarios.assertion: The new invoice appears under its matching query.

scenarios.title: Edit invoice
scenarios.assertion: The selected invoice update is visible after reload.

scenarios.title: Preview regression
scenarios.assertion: The same assertion detects a disclosed regression on the explicitly selected preview deployment.
